notes: WO-558 quest pack. Every template rides a WIRED Report() channel so it actually ticks to completion: combat.clear-waves (WaveManager.OnWaveCleared -> DailyQuestCombatBridge), explore.visit-gate (GateProximityOpener.OnHeroEntered), wildcard.earn-glimmer (GlimmerCurrencyService.TryAddGlimmer, reports amount), wildcard.learn-talent (WisdomCurrencyService.Unlock). Child ids (parent.child) tick on the parent event via DailyQuestService.Report StartsWith matching. The legacy non-ticking templates (frost-nova/sword-strike/hawks-eye/heart-below-30/no-ultimate/harvest-*/walk-all-gates/talk-heroes/increase-bond-rank/upgrade-tower/fortify-wall/equip-cosmetic/watch-intro) were REMOVED because no gameplay code reported them (dead quests that could roll but never complete) and the hero-specific ones conflict with the single-Knight north star. combat.build-towers is KEPT (day1Guaranteed; DailyQuestService.Day1QuestTemplateId const) but still has NO progress hook -- see WO-558 owner-decision flags. Labels only substitute {target} (the HUD does not substitute {element}). Reward dispensing on completion is not yet implemented (no QuestCompleted listener) -- slot rewards are config-only; see WO-558. Keep this file IDENTICAL to the StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical dual-copy.
